title: Build a multi-file language
description: This Makefile builds mylan from generated parser and lexer files plus AST and symbol-table sources.

steps.description: The variables set compilation flags, libraries, source files, and the target name.
The target links every source in SRCS into mylan.
Bison generates parser.tab.c and parser.tab.h. Flex generates lex.yy.c after the parser header exists.
clean removes the executable and generated parser and lexer files.
